fields.climate: temperate; hot and dry in southern and eastern desert areas
fields.terrain: Negev desert in the south; low coastal plain; central mountains; Jordan Rift Valley
fields.hazards: sandstorms may occur during spring and summer; droughts; periodic earthquakes
fields.resources: timber, potash, copper ore, natural gas, phosphate rock, magnesium bromide, clays, sand
fields.farm: milk, chicken, potatoes, tomatoes, tangerines/mandarins, bananas, eggs, avocados, beef, carrots/turnips
fields.exports: integrated circuits, diamonds, broadcasting equipment, medical instruments, refined petroleum
fields.industries: high-technology products (including aviation, communications, computer-aided design and manufactures, medical electronics, fiber optics), wood and paper products, potash and phosphates, food…
fields.languages: Hebrew (official), Arabic (special status under Israeli law), English (most commonly used foreign language)

independence.event: following League of Nations mandate under British administration

fields.legal: mixed system of English common law, British Mandate regulations, and Jewish, Christian, and Muslim religious laws
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal; 17 years of age for municipal elections
fields.military: 18-28 years of age for voluntary military service; 18 months service for men, 12 months for women; 18-21 years of age for compulsory military service for men and women…
